english.title: Permit use of motor vehicle - headlamp not lit in poor visibility / darkness
english.standardoffencewording:
On **(..SPECIFY DATE..) at **(..SPECIFY TOWNSHIP..) permitted **(..SPECIFY PERSON..) to use on a road, namely **(..SPECIFY ROAD AND LOCATION..), a vehicle, namely **(..SPECIFY VEHICLE MAKE AND INDEX NUMBER..), which was fitted with obligatory dipped-beam headlamps when not every such lamp was kept lit

(A)_[during the hours of darkness]_
(B)_[in seriously reduced visibility]_
english.legislation: Contrary to regulation 25(1) of the Road Vehicles Lighting Regulations 1989, section 42 of the Road Traffic Act 1988 and Schedule 2 to the Road Traffic Offenders Act 1988.
english.pointstoprove:
date and location
permit use on a road a motor vehicle fitted with
obligatory dipped-beam headlamp (s) not kept lit in
seriously reduced visibility/during the hours of darkness

investigatoraction.description: Guilty Plea by letter procedure may be offered for this offence
Confirm proposed charge is appropriately authorised (Police or CPS)
Ensure compliance with investigator's obligations re disclosure
Consider if case suitable for referral to Financial Investigation Unit and CPS for asset recovery eg confiscation order

english.notes:
(i) There is an exception for use of a vehicle during the hours of darkness on a restricted road (i.e. Restricted by virtue of a system of street lighting when it is lit). Other exceptions are contained within Regulation 25(2).
(ii) Statement of Facts procedure applies - see end of document for wording.
(iii) See also associated offence wordings as follows: H290 and H291.
english.standardstatementoffacts:
At **(..SPECIFY TIME..) on **(..SPECIFY DATE..) the defendant permitted **(..SPECIFY PERSON..) to use **(..SPECIFY VEHICLE MAKE AND INDEX NUMBER..) on **(..SPECIFY ROAD AND LOCATION..) at a time when visibility was reduced without the

(A)_[nearside headlamp ]_
(B)_[offside headlamp ]_
(C)_[headlamps ]_

being lit

(D)_[during the hours of darkness.]_
(E)_[in seriously reduced visibility.]_

other.penalty:
A fine not exceeding level three on the standard scale (level four if goods vehicle or vehicle adapted to carry more than eight passengers).

Time limit for prosecutions:
6 months
